clips.title: The story
paras: High above Gol'Bolar Quarry, Earthseer Farsen watches for Dark Iron movement in Dun Morogh. The visiting Wildhammer shaman uses farsight to reveal their growing infiltration near Ironforge, beginning a path toward the Hall of Thanes.

Earthseer Farsen keeps a vigilant watch over the lower reaches of Dun Morogh from above Gol'Bolar Quarry. He journeyed south from the crags of Aerie Peak, bringing a Wildhammer's spiritual awareness to lands usually patrolled by Ironforge mountaineers. Farsen uses his clan's traditional arts to sense subterranean rumblings and watch for unexpected movement along the hillsides.

Farsen lends travelers his farsight, a shamanic gift that carries awareness across great distances. Through this vision, you see that Dun Morogh's troubles reach beyond troggs and wild beasts. Dark Iron dwarves have slipped close to Ironforge's industrial center and are entrenching themselves for an operation that demands immediate confrontation before it takes root.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... A bit o' a Dark Iron traveler problem.
If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So ye see now, adventurer? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.
Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. How's about a bit o' violence?
